high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation titled "This is how models are built in traditional physics," attributed to Y. LeCun. The slide outlines the process of building models in traditional physics and includes a diagram illustrating the steps involved. Title: "This is how models are built in traditional physics" Subheadings: Find an abstract state representation that allows to make predictions Extract the state representation from observation/measurement Predict outcome resulting from an intervention/experiment Irrelevant and unpredictable information is eliminated from the representation T...
